title: Annotator-Centric Active Learning for Subjective NLP Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how well a model represents the full distribution of diverse human judgments, particularly minority opinions, using annotator-centric evaluation metrics such as Jensen-Shannon Divergence (to compare predicted and annotated distributions), Per-annotator F1-score, and Worst per-annotator F1-score (evaluating the performance on the bottom 10% of annotators based on Rawls' principle of fairness).
